title: 2018 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI/3 (2018-YDS/3) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. Several different models of emotional intelligence have emerged since 1990, and such ---- has contributed to a certain amount of controversy.
questions.explanation: Duygusal zekanın çeşitli (several different) modellerinin ortaya çıktığı belirtilmiş. Bu durumdaki 'çeşitlilik/farklılık' (diversity) miktarının bir miktar tartışmaya katkıda bulunduğu ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) elimination
B) diversity
C) regulation
D) clarity
E) disruption

questions.questionText: 2. Since the beginning of the Industrial Age, humankind's ---- of the natural environment has taken a turn for the worse.
questions.explanation: Sanayi Çağının başlangıcından bu yana, insanoğlunun doğal çevreyi 'sömürmesi'nin (exploitation) daha da kötüye gittiği anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) exploitation
B) contradiction
C) deprivation
D) termination
E) allocation

questions.questionText: 3. Although Thomas Edison was not the first to create the light bulb, his model was more ---- because it was long-lasting and formed part of a whole lighting system.
questions.explanation: Thomas Edison'un modeli ilk olmamasına rağmen, uzun ömürlü olması ve bütün bir aydınlatma sisteminin parçası olması nedeniyle daha 'ticari olarak uygulanabilir/başarılı' (commercially viable/successful) idi.
options: A) reactive
B) urgent
C) commercially
D) peculiar
E) arbitrary

questions.questionText: 4. Just as television and mass media had done before, the growth of the Internet in the 1990s and early 2000s ---- a new era for business.
questions.explanation: Tıpkı televizyonun daha önce yaptığı gibi, internetin büyümesi de iş dünyası için yeni bir dönemi 'müjdeledi / başlattı' (heralded).
options: A) heralded
B) jeopardised
C) reversed
D) enforced
E) protected

questions.questionText: 5. The revolutions and wars of the 20th century ---- affected people's views of the histories they wrote.
questions.explanation: 20. yüzyılın devrimleri ve savaşları insanların yazdıkları tarihlere dair görüşlerini 'derinden / köklü bir şekilde' (profoundly) etkiledi.
options: A) decently
B) recklessly
C) offensively
D) arbitrarily
E) profoundly

questions.questionText: 6. Since migrating to a digital format in the late 1990s, broadcasters, over time, have had to ---- their old analogue frequencies for the new digital channels and invest hundreds of millions of dollars in new equipment.
questions.explanation: Yayıncıların yeni dijital kanallar için eski analog frekanslarından 'vazgeçmek / bırakmak' (give up) zorunda kaldıkları ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) give up
B) take on
C) work out
D) turn down
E) go through

questions.questionText: 7. In recent years, linguists ---- whether the homogenising effects of TV, film, and the Internet ---- to eliminate many so-called regionalisms in the language in the US.
questions.explanation: 'In recent years' (son yıllarda) ifadesi Present Perfect (have pondered) gerektirir. 'Etkilerin ... ortadan kaldırmaya başlayıp başlamadığı' kısmı da süregelen veya tamamlanmış bir süreci anlattığı için yine Present Perfect (have begun) kullanımı en uygundur.
options: A) ponder / were beginning
B) have pondered / have begun
C) have been pondering / will have begun
D) are pondering / will be beginning
E) pondered / will begin

questions.questionText: 8. From asteroid strike to nuclear war, humanity ---- all kinds of existential threats, yet, if humankind disappeared tomorrow, nobody knows what kind of planet we ---- behind.
questions.explanation: İnsanlık şimdiye kadar tüm tehditlerle 'yüzleşti/karşılaştı' (has faced). 'if humankind disappeared tomorrow' (Eğer insanlık yarın yok olursa) varsayımsal bir Type 2 if koşuludur, bu yüzden devamında 'would be leaving' (bırakıyor olurduk) kullanılmalıdır.
options: A) faced / should be leaving
B) has faced / would be leaving
C) had faced / may be leaving
D) is facing / have to be leaving
E) faces / must be leaving

questions.questionText: 9. After ---- victorious from World War I, structural problems and massive debt plunged Great Britain into an economic crisis that ---- into the middle of the 1930s.
questions.explanation: Bir edat olan 'After'dan sonra fiil -ing takısı alır (emerging). Krizin 1930'ların ortalarına kadar 'sürdüğü' geçmişteki net bir süreç olduğundan Simple Past (lasted) kullanılır.
options: A) to emerge / was lasting
B) having been emerged / has lasted
C) having emerged / would have lasted
D) emerging / lasted
E) being emerged / had lasted

questions.questionText: 10. The world's first complex societies arose in the Near East in the fertile area, KNOWN AS Mesopotamia, ---- the Tigris and Euphrates Rivers.
questions.explanation: Yakın Doğu 'içinde' (within) ve Dicle ile Fırat Nehirleri 'arasında' (between) anlamı B şıkkında doğru edatlarla verilmiştir.
options: A) around / to
B) within / between
C) about / with
D) for / along
E) at / among

questions.questionText: 11. ---- rapid advances in biotechnology, genetic manipulation of crops accelerated in the 1990s and is expected to have a significant impact ---- food production.
questions.explanation: Biyoteknolojideki hızlı ilerlemeler 'ile birlikte' (With) ve gıda üretimi 'üzerinde' (on) etki sahibi olması (impact on) kullanımları doğrudur.
options: A) Through / to
B) In / over
C) With / on
D) Within / from
E) For / behind

questions.questionText: 12. Scientists have grown more aware of the social implications of their work ---- people have become more conscious of the ways in which science and technology affect their lives.
questions.explanation: İnsanların bilim ve teknolojinin hayatlarını nasıl etkilediğinin daha fazla farkına varmalarıyla 'aynı anda / tıpkı onun gibi' (just as) bilim insanları da çalışmalarının etkilerinin farkına varmıştır.
options: A) but
B) in case
C) just as
D) only if
E) unless

questions.questionText: 13. ---- the organic food industry is relatively small and new, it is important that consumers become aware of its claims, limitations, and potential benefits.
questions.explanation: Organik gıda endüstrisi nispeten küçük ve yeni olsa 'bile / rağmen' (Even if), tüketicilerin bunun fayda ve sınırlarının farkına varması önemlidir zıtlığı kurulmuştur.
options: A) Just as
B) Once
C) Unless
D) Even if
E) Until

questions.questionText: 14. Early conceptualisations of acculturation described an interpersonal transformation that occurs ---- cultures come into sustained contact.
questions.explanation: Kültürleşmenin erken kavramsallaştırmaları, kültürler sürekli temas haline 'geldiğinde' (when) meydana gelen bir dönüşümü tanımlamıştır.
options: A) whereas
B) when
C) as
D) even though
E) in case

questions.questionText: 15. Known as the 'Lady with the Lamp' during the Crimean War, Florence Nightingale, the most famous nurse in history, focused her efforts on ---- the prevention of diseases ---- the promotion of healthy living in a more positive way.
questions.explanation: Çabalarını 'sadece' hastalıkların önlenmesine 'değil, aynı zamanda' sağlıklı yaşamın teşvik edilmesine odakladı anlamını veren 'not only / but also' kalıbı kullanılmalıdır.
options: A) the more / the more
B) not only / but also
C) whether / or
D) such / that
E) as / as

questions.questionText: 16. ---- expansion west across the Mississippi River to the Pacific coast, settlers from Europe were brought into conflict with Native American tribes who lived in the area, upon whose lands the settlers were encroaching.
questions.explanation: Mississippi Nehri'nin batısına doğru olan genişleme 'yüzünden / sebebiyle' (Due to) Avrupalı yerleşimciler Kızılderili kabileleriyle çatışmaya girmişlerdir.
options: A) Rather than
B) Along with
C) As opposed to
D) Unlike
E) Due to

questions.questionText: 17. The humble plastic bottle is now one of the most commonly recycled objects. However, it was the cheapness and durability of the product that (17)---- its popularity over glass bottles.
questions.explanation: Plastik şişenin cam şişelere karşı popülerliğine 'yol açan' (led to) şey ucuzluğu ve dayanıklılığıydı.
options: A) led to
B) sold off
C) wore out
D) brought down
E) called back

questions.questionText: 18. Nathaniel Wyeth, a US engineer, worked on the invention (18)---- almost a decade.
questions.explanation: Zaman periyodu bildirirken 'yaklaşık on yıl boyunca' anlamında 'for' edatı kullanılır.
options: A) with
B) for
C) at
D) to
E) by

questions.questionText: 19. When he asked a colleague if plastic might be used to store carbonated beverages (19)---- coke, he was told that they would explode.
questions.explanation: Kola 'gibi' (such as) karbonatlı içecekler şeklinde bir örneklendirme yapılmıştır.
options: A) contrary to
B) rather than
C) by means of
D) such as
E) in terms of

questions.questionText: 20. Obviously, the plastic was too weak, but it (20)---- if the long strands of molecules that form plastic were made up together.
questions.explanation: Plastik zayıftı, ancak uzun molekül iplikçikleri birbirine bağlanırsa 'güçlendirilmesi gerekiyordu' / 'güçlendirilebilirdi'. Boşluğa geçmişte zorunluluk/ihtiyaç bildiren 'had to be strengthened' uygundur.
options: A) used to be strengthened
B) had to be strengthened
C) would have been strengthened
D) must have been strengthened
E) should be strengthened

questions.questionText: 21. (21)---- initial results were far from successful and it took 10,000 attempts to solve that problem, he finally replaced the nylon with polyethylene-terphathalate (PET)...
questions.explanation: İlk sonuçlar başarılı olmaktan uzak 'olmasına rağmen' (Although), sonunda naylonu PET ile değiştirmeyi başardı.
options: A) Since
B) As long as
C) In order that
D) Although
E) In case

questions.questionText: 22. Walson and his wife Margaret, owners of the Service Electric Company of Mahanoy City, Pennsylvania, (22)---- cable television as a way to help their customers pick up signals blocked by nearby mountains.
questions.explanation: Kablo televizyon fikrini müşterilerine yardım etmenin bir yolu olarak 'buldular / ortaya attılar' (came up with) anlamı uygundur.
options: A) lived up to
B) caught up with
C) came up with
D) grew out of
E) kept up with

questions.questionText: 23. Walson decided (23)---- his service literally to new heights by climbing to the top of a mountain and planting an antenna.
questions.explanation: Decide fiilinden sonra 'to infinitive' kullanılır. Hizmetini yeni boyutlara 'taşımaya karar verdi' (decided to take).
options: A) to take
B) to be taking
C) having taken
D) to have taken
E) taking

questions.questionText: 24. (24)---- using cables and signal boosters, he connected the antenna to his appliance store.
questions.explanation: Kabloları ve sinyal güçlendiricileri 'kullandıktan sonra' (After) anteni mağazasına bağladığı olayların sırasını belirtir.
options: A) until
B) though
C) thus
D) after
E) but

questions.questionText: 25. Along the way he dropped the signal directly off at his customers' homes, (25)---- creating the first community antenna television system.
questions.explanation: Sinyali müşterilerin evlerine bırakarak, 'böylece' (thus) ilk topluluk anten televizyon sistemini yarattığı bir sonuç/çıkarım bildirir.
options: A) until
B) though
C) thus
D) after
E) but

questions.questionText: 26. Community antenna television, now known as cable TV, is found in nearly 60 per cent of US homes and (26)---- Europe.
questions.explanation: Kablo TV'nin Avrupa 'çapında / boyunca' (throughout) bulunduğu ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) beneath
B) throughout
C) besides
D) between
E) opposite

questions.questionText: 27. Although airborne radar shares much in common with surface and naval sets, ---.
questions.explanation: Havadan taşınan radarın yüzey ve donanma setleriyle pek çok ortak noktası olmasına rağmen (Although), 'onu bunlardan ayıran birçok faktör vardır' diyerek zıtlık mükemmel şekilde tamamlanmıştır.
options: A) there are many factors involved that set it apart from these
B) they were first developed and used during World War II
C) the radar set itself needs to fit in the limited space available within an airplane
D) home sets have a margin of error of around five kilometers and a visual range of 300 meters
E) their development was hindered by directives prohibiting external antennae on planes

questions.questionText: 28. Although we may think that we come to our opinions independently, --
questions.explanation: Fikirlerimize bağımsız olarak ulaştığımızı düşünsek de (Although), 'araştırmalar insanların grup normlarından derinden etkilendiğini göstermektedir' ifadesi mantıklı bir zıtlıktır.
options: A) research shows that people are profoundly influenced by group norms at all levels of thought and behaviour
B) we might go against group norms and make a unique decision despite feelings of anxiety and fear
C) studies of the brain indicate increased activation of the amygdala region when making an independent decision
D) people are less swayed by group opinions when they are more knowledgeable or confident
E) most of us consider decisions about clothes to be personal and do not worry about others' opinions

questions.questionText: 29. While the percentage of North Americans practicing vegetarianism has remained rather consistent at about only one per cent of the total population, ----.
questions.explanation: Vejetaryenlik oranı %1 gibi sabit bir seviyede kalmasına rağmen (While), 'bu yaşam tarzının sosyal kabulü önemli ölçüde artmıştır' (social acceptance... has increased dramatically).
options: A) social acceptance of this lifestyle has increased dramatically since the late 20th century
B) there is some controversy related to which dietary practices truly fall under the term 'vegetarianism'
C) such lifestyles have rarely been understood well by communities dependent on animal products
D) most of them believe that practicing vegetarianism helps them with their weight loss goals
E) the philosophy of vegetarianism dates back to the views of Pythagoras in the 5th century BC

questions.questionText: 30. Because obesity, ---- has become more prevalent, ----.
questions.explanation: Obezite daha yaygın hale geldiği için (Because), 'halk sağlığı uzmanları sağlık sistemleri ve toplum üzerinde çok ağır bir yük/bedel beklemektedirler' cümlesi uygun bir nedensel sonuçtur.
options: A) the highest prevalence is in Polynesia and Micronesia
B) followed by Kuwait, and the US
C) public health experts are expecting a very heavy toll on health systems and society
D) the same applies to kids, teenagers, young adults and adults alike around the world
E) cheap junk food, rural-to-urban migration and sedentary lifestyles all contribute to obesity

questions.questionText: 31. As the human population continues to increase, ----.
questions.explanation: İnsan nüfusu artmaya devam ettikçe, 'insanlar makineler ve araçlarla daha fazla iç içe geçeceğinden dünyamızdaki gürültü miktarı da artacaktır' ifadesi mantıklı bir öngörüdür.
options: A) many engineers are unaware that noise pollution is a serious problem especially in developing countries
B) as many as 10 million people lost part of their hearing because of noise pollution
C) manufacturers in some states do not label the noise level of products such as chain saws and lawn mowers
D) the amount of noise in our world will also grow since we crowd together with gadgets, machines, and vehicles
E) laws force manufacturers to specify the noise levels of their products, which should not exceed the acceptable levels

questions.questionText: 32. ----, all too frequently technological devices or particular features are not adequate for the needs and abilities of older people.
questions.explanation: Çok sık olarak teknolojik cihazların yaşlıların ihtiyaçlarına yetersiz kalması, 'üreticilerin ürünleri mümkün olduğunca kullanıcı dostu yapmaya çalışmalarına rağmen' (Even though) gerçeği ile zıtlık oluşturur.
options: A) As problems of access to technological devices experienced by older people emerge when they have to change their habitual behaviours
B) Even though developers and manufacturers of technical devices and systems attempt to make products as user-friendly as possible
C) As long as acceptance of technology becomes crucial for older people for the acquisition and use of technological appliances
D) Whereas elderly non-users of technological devices run the risk of being labelled technologically illiterate
E) In case older people who grew up with electro-mechanical interaction style devices experience more difficulties

questions.questionText: 33. No accurate statistics for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) exist ----.
questions.explanation: ADHD için kesin istatistikler yoktur, 'çünkü (as) semptomları neredeyse her normal, sağlıklı insanda gelir, gider ve zamanla kaybolur'.
options: A) given that it is classified as a disability under federal laws and legislation in the United States
B) when 70% of true cases exhibit psychological problems such as depression and anxiety
C) because experts have grown alarmed by the increase in the number of individuals diagnosed with the disorder
D) as its symptoms come and go in almost every normal, healthy person and vanish in time
E) unless many psychiatrists maintain that the disorder has become overdiagnosed

questions.questionText: 34. Much of the ocean, ----
questions.explanation: Okyanusun büyük bir kısmı derindir ve 'karanlık, soğuk koşullar onun derin sularının keşfedilmesini zorlaştırır' ifadesi coğrafi gerçeği mantıklı bir şekilde devam ettirir. (OCR eksikliğinden dolayı anlamca en uygun mantıksal cümle parçası D şıkkındadır).
options: A) unless they could surface
B) even if it covers more of the Earth's surface than land
C) unique characteristics to survive in those conditions
D) the dark, cold conditions make its deep waters difficult to explore
E) although life at the bottom of the deep ocean is difficult

questions.questionText: 35. ----, the ethnic characteristics and traditions of the Balkan Peninsula's food culture have been well preserved.
questions.explanation: Balkan Yarımadası'nın yemek kültürünün etnik özellikleri iyi korunmuştur, 'son birkaç yüzyılda doğu etkisi çok güçlü olmasına rağmen' (Even though the eastern influence has been very strong...).
options: A) Provided that it displays both Asian and western European influences
B) Even if meat might not have played a central role in the past
C) Even though the eastern influence has been very strong in the last several centuries
D) As long as its food culture is shaped by the historic, social and climatic elements
E) While the use of numerous spices constitutes the basics of its cuisine

questions.questionText: 36. The Sung dynasty Chinese (AD 960-1279) had the technology to make rockets, ----.
questions.explanation: Çinliler roket yapma teknolojisine sahipti, 'ancak bunu yaptıklarına dair kesin bir kanıt yoktur' (but there is no definitive evidence that they did so).
options: A) so the first European picture of a rocket was made in 1400
B) thus it was occasionally used as a weapon by Europeans
C) because the earliest European recipe for black powder appeared in 1265
D) but there is no definitive evidence that they did so
E) as the origin of the rocket is shrouded in mystery

questions.questionText: 37. As a result of dramatically increased communication between people in recent years, we live in a world that is increasingly multilingual, where languages we speak are no longer confined to a specific geographical area.
questions.explanation: İngilizce cümlede yer alan 'As a result of dramatically increased communication between people in recent years' ifadesi 'Son yıllarda insanlar arasında önemli ölçüde artan iletişimin sonucu olarak' şeklinde çevrilmelidir. Sonrasındaki 'we live in a world... where languages we speak are no longer confined to a specific geographical area' ise 'konuştuğumuz dillerin artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeyle sınırlandırılmadığı... bir dünyada yaşıyoruz' şeklinde en doğru E seçeneğinde verilmiştir.
options: A) Insanlar arasındaki iletişim son yıllarda önemli ölçüde arttı ve bunun sonucunda konuştuğumuz dillerin artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeyle sınırlandırılmadığı, giderek çok dilli olan bir dünyada yaşıyoruz.
B) Son yıllarda insanlar arasındaki iletişimin konuştuğumuz dillerin artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeye özgü olmadığı, giderek çok dilli hâle gelen bir dünyada yaşamamızın bir sonucudur.

C) Konuştuğumuz dillerin artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeyle sınırlandırılmış olmaması sonucunda giderek çok dilli hale gelen bir dünyada yaşadığımız için insanlar arasındaki iletişim son yıllarda önemli ölçüde arttı.
D) Son yıllarda insanlar arasındaki iletişimin büyük ölçüde artması sonucunda konuştuğumuz dilleri giderek çok dilli olan ve artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeye özgü olmadığı bir dünyada yaşıyoruz.

E) Son yıllarda insanlar arasında önemli ölçüde artan iletişimin sonucu olarak, konuştuğumuz dillerin artık belirli bir coğrafi bölgeyle sınırlandırılmadığı, giderek çok dilli hâle gelen bir dünyada yaşıyoruz.

questions.questionText: 38. In the West, meditation is regarded as a cure for depression, as a recipe for happiness, and it is even advised for pain relief when the drugs fail, yet in Asia, it represents a spiritual exploration of the mind.
questions.explanation: Burada cümlenin öznesi olan Meditation (Meditasyon) öne alınarak 'Batı'da ... olarak görülen ve hatta ... tavsiye edilen meditasyon, Asya'da zihnin ruhani bir keşfini temsil eder' yapısı kullanılmıştır. C şıkkı, 'yet in Asia' kısmını ana cümle yüklemi yaparak anlamı zarifçe verir.
options: A) Meditasyon, her ne kadar Batı'da depresyon için bir tedavi, mutluluk için bir reçete olarak görülse ve hatta İlaçlar yetersiz kaldığında ağrıdan kurtulmak için tavsiye edilse de bu uygulama Asya'da, zihnin ruhani bir keşfini simgeler.
B) Asya'da zihnin ruhani bir keşfini temsil eden meditasyon, Batı'da depresyon için bir tedavi, mutluluk için bir reçete olarak görülür ve ilaçların ağrıyı gidermediği durumlarda bile tavsiye edilir.

C) Batı'da, depresyonun tedavisi, mutluluk için bir reçete olarak görülen ve ilaçların yetersiz kaldığı durumlarda ağrıdan kurtulmak için tavsiye edilen meditasyon, Asya'da zihnin ruhani bir keşfini temsil eder.

D) Batı'da meditasyonun depresyon için bir tedavi, mutluluk için bir reçete olarak görülmesine ve hatta ilaçların yetersiz kaldığı durumlarda ağrıdan kurtulmak için tavsiye edilmesine rağmen Asya'da zihnin ruhani bir keşfini simgeler.

E) Meditasyon, Batı'da depresyon için bir tedavi, mutluluk için bir reçete olarak görülür ve hatta ilaçlar yetersiz kaldığında ağrıdan kurtulmak için tavsiye edilir ancak Asya'da zihnin ruhani bir keşfini temsil eder.

questions.questionText: 39. Persuasive communication designed to arouse fear is usually effective; however, if the message arouses too much fear, the effects may be disruptive and lead people to ignore or reject the information.
questions.explanation: Cümle birebir olarak şu şekilde çevrilir: 'Korku uyandırmak için tasarlanmış ikna edici iletişim (Persuasive communication designed to arouse fear) genellikle etkilidir (is usually effective); ancak, mesaj çok fazla korku uyandırırsa (if the message arouses too much fear), etkiler yıkıcı/rahatsız edici olabilir (the effects may be disruptive) ve insanların bilgiyi görmezden gelmesine veya reddetmesine yol açabilir (lead people to ignore or reject...).' B şıkkı tam karşılıktır.
options: A) Korku uyandırmaya yönelik ikna edici İletişim genelde etkilidir ama çok fazla korku yaratan mesajın etkileri rahatsızlık verebilir ve kişiler tarafından bilginin göz ardı edilmesine veya reddedilmesine neden olabilir.

B) Korku uyandırmaya yönelik ikna edici iletişim genellikle etkilidir ancak mesaj çok fazla korku yaratırsa, etkileri rahatsız edici olabilir ve kişilerin bilgiyi göz ardı etmesine veya reddetmesine yol açabilir.

C) ikna edici iletişim korku uyandırmaya yönelik olduğunda genellikle etkilidir fakat mesaj gereğinden fazla korku yaratırsa, etkileri rahatsızlık verici olabilir ve bilginin kişiler tarafından göz ardı edilmesi veya reddedilmesiyle sonuçlanır.
D) ikna etmeye yönelik iletişim genelde etkilidir ancak etkileri rahatsızlık verip çok fazla korku yaratırsa, bilginin kişiler tarafından göz ardı edilmesine veya reddedilmesine neden olur.

E) Ikna etmeye yönelik iletişim korku uyandırdığında genelde etkilidir lakar fazla korku uyandırdığı durumlarda mesajın etkileri rahatsız edici olabilir ve kisilerin bilgiyi göz ardı etmesine veya reddetmesine neden olur.

questions.questionText: 40. Kaslarımız, egzersizden sonra, stresin neden olduğu kynurenine adı verilen toksini etkisiz hale getiren bir bileşen üretmektedir, ancak günlük yürüyüş bu bileşenin üretimini artırmak için yeterli değildir.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin ilk kısmının doğru İngilizce dizilimi: 'After a workout, our muscles produce a compound which neutralises a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine'. İkinci kısmı: 'but a daily walk is not enough to boost the production of this compound.' şeklindedir. D seçeneği bunu tam karşılar.
options: A) Following a workout, our muscles neutralise a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine by producing a compound, though a daily walk will not be enough to boost the production of this compound.
B) A compound is produced by our muscles via workout to neutralise a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine, but a daily walk is not enough to boost the production of this compound.
C) A daily walk is not enough to boost the production of a compound, produced by our muscles after a workout, that neutralises a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine.
D) After a workout, our muscles produce a compound which neutralises a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine, but a daily walk is not enough to boost the production of this compound.
E) After a workout, our muscles produce a compound to neutralise a stress-induced toxin called kynurenine, because walking daily is not enough to boost the production of this compound.

questions.questionText: 41. Modern çocuk romanları, tüm bir hayat hikâyesinden ziyade çarpıcı bir dönüm noktasına odaklanarak, nispeten kısa bir zaman aralığını kapsama eğilimindedir; bu nedenle çocuk romanlarında daha az özet ve daha detaylı sahneler vardır.
questions.explanation: Türkçe metindeki '... kapsama eğilimindedir' (tend to cover), '... odaklanarak' (concentrating on), 'bu nedenle' (therefore) gibi bağlaç ve eylemler B şıkkında kusursuz sıralanmıştır.
options: A) Modern children's novels tend to concentrate on a dramatic turning point Instead of a whole life story with more detailed scenes and fewer summaries; and thus there is a much shorter time span in children's books.

B) Modern children's novels tend to cover a relatively short time span, concentrating on a dramatic turning point rather than a whole life story; therefore, there are fewer summaries and more detailed scenes in children's books.

C) There is a tendency in modern children's novels to cover a relatively short time span, so they focus on a dramatic turning point instead of a whole life story and there are fewer summaries and more detailed scenes in children's books.

D) Modern children's novels tend to cover a relatively short time span instead of a whole life story so that they can focus on a dramatic turning point; therefore, there are fewer summaries and more detailed scenes in children's books.
E) Modern children's novels tend to focus on a dramatic turning point instead of a whole life story, and consequently there are fewer summaries and more detailed scenes in children's books.

questions.questionText: 42. Bağışıklık sistemi; zararlı bakteriler, virüsler ve parazitleri vücuttan uzak tutmaya ve istilacı ajanları yok etmeye çalışan bir sistemdir ve bu sistem vücutta sorun arayarak devriye gezen beyaz kan hücreleri ordusundan oluşmaktadır.
questions.explanation: Bağışıklık sisteminin tanımını yapan ilk cümle ('The immune system is a system that tries to keep... out of the body and to destroy invading agents') ve devamında bu sistemin içeriğini açıklayan ikinci cümle ('and this system consists of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body, looking for trouble') C şıkkında doğru tercüme edilmiştir.
options: A) The system that tries to keep harmful bacteria, viruses and parasites out of the body and to destroy invading agents is called the immune system, which consists of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body, looking for trouble.

B) Consisting of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body, the immune system is a system that looks for trouble trying to keep harmful bacteria, viruses and parasites out of the body and to fight with invading agents.

C) The immune system is a system that tries to keep harmful bacteria, viruses and parasites out of the body and to destroy invading agents, and this system consists of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body, looking for trouble.

D) The immune system, which consists of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body and looks for trouble, is a system that tries to keep harmful bacteria, viruses and parasites out of the body and to destroy invading agents.

E) The immune system tries to keep harmful bacteria, viruses and parasites out of the body and to fight with invading agents, and this system, which looks for trouble, consists of an army of white blood cells that patrols the body.

questions.questionText: 43. It is stated in the passage that aromatherapy ----.
questions.explanation: Pasajda 'There is evidence that the Chinese may have recognised the benefits of herbal and aromatic remedies much earlier than this' (Çinlilerin Mısırlılardan çok daha önce faydalarını anladığı) ifadesinden hareketle, Çinlilerin şifa amaçlı bunu Mısırlılardan çok önce kullanmış olabileceği (was possibly used for curative purposes by the Chinese long before the Egyptians) seçeneği doğrudur.
options: A) is still practised through the use of more than 200 plants listed in Pen Ts'ao
B) had been ignored for years until the ancient Egyptians made use of it
C) was more highly valued by the Indians than the Chinese and Egyptians
D) was possibly used for curative purposes by the Chinese long before the Egyptians
E) is described as a form of treatment for severe psychological disorders

questions.questionText: 44. Greek physician and surgeon Pedanios Dioscorides ----.
questions.explanation: Pasajın sonunda, Pedanios Dioscorides'in 1500 yıl boyunca Batı tıbbının standart ders kitabı olan ünlü eseri De Materia Medica'yı (tıbbi amaçla kullanılan bitkilere odaklanan kitap) yazdığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.
options: A) differed from Roman physicians and surgeons in that he recorded his knowledge of curative herbs
B) wrote a book on medicine which focused on herbs that could be used for medicinal purposes
C) insisted that botanicals had more value in medicine compared to religious ceremonies
D) was the first to fully understand and document the medicinal value of botanical aromatics
E) drew inspiration from the Romans in his efforts to improve Western medicine

questions.questionText: 45. The underlined word 'prominent' in the passage is closest in meaning to ----.
questions.explanation: 'Prominent' kelimesi 'seçkin, önemli, dikkate değer' anlamlarına gelir. Bu anlama en yakın olan seçenek 'noteworthy' (dikkate değer) sözcüğüdür.
options: A) noteworthy
B) consistent
C) prescriptive
D) equivalent
E) confidential

questions.questionText: 46. What is the main purpose of the passage?
questions.explanation: Paragraf aromaterapinin tanımını yaparak tarih boyunca Mısırlılar, Çinliler, Hintliler, Romalılar ve Yunanlar gibi farklı medeniyetler tarafından nasıl ve hangi amaçlarla geliştirildiğini (civilisations that contributed to the growth of aromatherapy) incelemektedir.
options: A) To highlight the pleasurable quality of aromatic plants
B) To mention the eminent physicians practising aromatherapy
C) To discuss the reasons why aromatherapy was used in ancient times
D) To prove the medicinal value of aromatherapy
E) To give information about the civilisations that contributed to the growth of aromatherapy

questions.questionText: 47. Which of the following is an effect of low atmospheric pressure on Mars?
questions.explanation: Metinde 'Düşük atmosfer basıncı sayesinde, su hemen hemen anında kaynayıp uçar (boils away almost instantly)' denilmiştir, bu da suyun kaynayıp anında yok olduğu (boils and disappears immediately) anlamına gelir.
options: A) Water cannot be formed during the warm summer days of Mars.
B) The water formed on Mars boils and disappears immediately.
C) The temperatures fall and so water cannot boil.
D) The planet becomes too cold for any water to exist
E) The summer period is affected less by this low pressure.

questions.questionText: 48. Why did the researchers recreate two environments?
questions.explanation: Araştırmacılar Dünya ve Mars benzeri iki ortam oluşturarak 'bu kısa ömürlü kaynayan suyun önemli bir jeolojik etki yaratıp yaratmadığını' (investigate if the fast boiling water had an effect on Mars) test etmek istemişlerdir.
options: A) They wanted to compare the environment of Earth with the environment of Mars
B) They wanted to see if it was possible to create Mars-like environments.
C) They wanted to find out if it would be possible to create Earth-like conditions on Mars.
D) They wanted to investigate if the fast boiling water had an effect on Mars.
E) They were trying to see if they could stop water boiling away instantly.

questions.questionText: 49. It is stated in the passage that ice melting under Mars-like pressure ----.
questions.explanation: Mars benzeri basınçta buz eridiğinde, kaynamanın 'kumu bozan kabarcıklar yayılmasına ve Mars yüzeyinde görülenlere benzer bir çıkıntı/sırt deseni bırakmasına' ('bubbles to be emitted which disturbed the sand, leaving a pattern of ridges...') neden olduğu belirtilmiştir.
options: A) created bubbles that disturbed the sand, leaving a pattern of ridges.
B) soaked into the sand and disappeared.
C) was absorbed into the sand and left salt on the surface.
D) melted immediately and left no patterns on the surface.
E) had a similar effect as ice melting under Earth conditions.

questions.questionText: 50. It can be inferred from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde en sıcak yaz günlerinde Mars'ta sıvı su oluştuğu ('liquid water forms'), ancak düşük basınçtan ötürü hemen kaynayarak yok olduğu anlatılmaktadır. Bu da Mars'ın su oluşturabileceği ama onu muhafaza edemeyeceği (unable to preserve it) anlamına gelir.
options: A) the findings of the research make it clear that Mars could be a habitable planet for humans
B) scientists need to start working on how to balance the atmospheric pressure on Mars
C) Mars has a suitable environment for water to be formed, but is unable to preserve it
D) it is possible to create Earth-like environments on Mars
E) water formed on Mars towards the end of summer days does not vaporise easily

questions.questionText: 51. It can be understood from the passage that the Galápagos ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde bu çıplak kayalık adaların bitki ve hayvanlar tarafından kolonileştirildiği ve bunların Dünya'da başka hiçbir yerde bulunmayan tuhaf biçimlere ('weird forms found nowhere else on Earth') yani eşsiz türlere evrildiği belirtilmiştir.
options: A) are no longer volcanically active
B) hardly have fertile soils to feed creatures
C) are bare rocks with no indication of plant or animal life
D) will crash into South America in the near future
E) came to be the home of unique species in the course of time

questions.questionText: 52. It is clearly stated in the passage that the Galápagos ----.
questions.explanation: Metnin sonunda adaların büyük bir turist çekim merkezi olmasına rağmen çoğunun 'çağdaş dünyanın neredeyse hiç dokunmadığı büyülü niteliğini koruduğu' ('retain the magical quality of a place almost untouched by the contemporary world') açıkça ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) have been a central tourist site for its peculiar culture
B) have been a very popular tourist destination especially for scientists
C) have been virtually unaffected by the modern world
D) attract thousands of tourists from South America every year
E) magically make people forget about the modern world

questions.questionText: 53. Which word is closest in meaning to the underlined word 'lush' in the passage?
questions.explanation: 'Lush' bitki örtüsü için kullanıldığında sık, verimli, gür ve 'bol/bereketli' anlamına gelir. Bu nedenle 'abundant' en yakın anlamlı kelimedir.
options: A) compact
B) decaying
C) available
D) rare
E) abundant

questions.questionText: 54. Which of the following questions does this passage mostly answer?
questions.explanation: Paragraf Galapagos adalarının nasıl oluştuğunu, kıta sahanlığındaki hareketini, eşsiz vahşi yaşamını ve neden turist çektiğini açıklamaktadır, yani genel olarak 'Galapagos'u bu kadar ilginç yapan nedir?' sorusuna cevap vermektedir.
options: A) What makes the Galápagos so interesting?
B) What is so wonderful about the volcanic landscape of the Galápagos?
C) Why do the Galápagos continuously move?
D) What plants and animals live on the most western island of Fernandina?
E) What is the scientific importance of the Galápagos?

questions.questionText: 55. Why are textbooks used for training teachers in the 1960s mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: Eskiden gündüz düşü görmenin her zaman sağlıklı kabul edilmediği, örneğin 1960'larda öğretmen eğitim kitaplarının bununla 'mücadele etme stratejileri' (strategies for combating daydreaming) sunduğu belirtilmiş. Yani geçmişte bunun normal bir fenomen olarak görülmediğini (not seen as a normal phenomenon in the past) kanıtlamak için bahsedilmiştir.
options: A) To state that these textbooks explained the reasons why students tend to daydream
B) To show that teachers favoured psychologists' view that daydreaming is healthy
C) To emphasise that teachers were advised not to criticise their students for daydreaming
D) To focus on strategies developed by psychologists to help teachers deal with daydreaming
E) To indicate that daydreaming was not seen as a normal phenomenon in the past

questions.questionText: 56. It is clear from the passage that daydreaming ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde gündüz düşlerinin biyolojik sıcaklık döngüleri ve hormon seviyeleri (bodily factors) tarafından ayarlanabildiği veya beş duyu gibi duyusal girdilerle (sensory stimuli) tetiklenebildiği ('triggered by a sensory input') ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) happens for about 90 minutes, usually around lunchtime
B) becomes a permanent habit after the age of three
C) generally appeals to all of our five senses simultaneously
D) is initiated either by bodily factors or sensory stimuli
E) peaks at lunch time due to an increase in the amount of sensory input

questions.questionText: 57. Which of the following is true about daydreaming?
questions.explanation: Parçada, pozitif hayaller kuran çocukların yetişkinlikte sorun çözme ve yaratıcılıkta başarılı olduğu; negatif veya korkutucu hayaller kuran çocukların ise korku ve endişelerinin yetişkinliğe taşındığı ('this pattern will carry over into adulthood as well') belirtilmektedir.
options: A) While children generally benefit from the positive aspects of daydreaming, adults often focus on negative sides of their daydreams.
B) Daydreams can be highly detrimental if a person often confuses them with reality and behaves the way he or she does in daydreams.
C) Children's daydreams might trigger beneficial or harmful behavioural patterns in their adult years.
D) When a child's daydreams become visible, they must be interpreted correctly to help him or her become a creative or successful adult.
E) Daydreams generally disappear after the age of ten when they are largely internalised.

questions.questionText: 58. Which could be the best title for this passage?
questions.explanation: Paragraf, gündüz düşlerinin (hayal kurmanın) ne olduğu, tarihsel algısı, sebepleri ve çocukluktan yetişkinliğe nasıl devam ettiği hakkında kapsamlı bir açıklama ('Daydreaming Explained') sunmaktadır.
options: A) Comparing Child and Adult Daydreamers
B) Daydreaming Explained
C) Daydreams: Natural or Unhealthy?
D) The Transfer of Earlier Daydreams into Adulthood
E) The Underlying Causes of Daydreams

questions.questionText: 59. According to the passage, the most important thing for all organisms is to ----.
questions.explanation: Paragrafın ilk cümlesinde 'biz insanlar tehlikeden kaçınmayı en yüksek önceliğimiz yaparız' ve devamında tüm canlıların bunu yapmazsa hayatta kalamayacağı (avoiding danger) ifade ediliyor. 'Stay away from life threatening situations', tehlikeden kaçınmak demektir.
options: A) hide well for better protection in nature
B) stay away from life threatening situations
C) devote a great deal of energy for the search of food
D) choose the right habitat to be able to survive
E) keep up with the requirements of finding food

questions.questionText: 60. It is clearly stated in the passage that in order to survive, animals should ----.
questions.explanation: Yazar 'Öğle yemeğini kaçırmak, öğle yemeği olmaktan iyidir' ve 'Sadece beslenirken avcıları sürekli gözleyen tavşanlar bu dünyada yaşamaya devam eder' diyerek beslenirken av olmaktan kaçınmanın önemini ('avoid becoming prey while feeding themselves') vurgulamıştır.
options: A) try to get adequate nutrition during the day
B) be careful about the food choices they make
C) avoid becoming prey while feeding themselves
D) be engaged in less physical activity while eating
E) avoid hunting in places far from their original habitats

questions.questionText: 61. Compared to animals' survival strategies, those of humans ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde insanların diğer hayvanların aksine geçmişi ve olası gelecekleri 'tanımlayabildikleri/anlatabildikleri' ('describe the past and possible futures') ve buna göre düşünüp endişelenebildikleri belirtilmiştir, bu da daha karmaşık bir muhakeme (reasoning) seviyesini içerir.
options: A) are based on bad experiences rather than realistic worries
B) make them less vulnerable to possible attacks and threats
C) are less powerful in terms of foreseeing the coming danger
D) are basically effective in dealing with present dangers
E) involve a more complex level of reasoning and imagination

questions.questionText: 62. One can understand from the passage that our communication skills and thinking abilities ----.
questions.explanation: Paragrafın sonunda, sözel ve ilişkisel yeteneklerimiz sayesinde 'tamamen güvenli ve sessiz bir odada otururken bile korkunç bir dünyada (zihinsel olarak) yaşayabildiğimiz' belirtilmiştir. Bu da diğer türlere göre tehlike (ya da hayal edilen tehlike) karşısında kendimizi daha dehşete düşmüş hissetmemize (make us feel more horrified) yol açar.
options: A) allow us to intuitively abstain ourselves from putting our lives at risk without action
B) may sometimes be ineffective in helping us estimate the risks around us
C) lead us to have a deeply pessimistic perspective on our future
D) make us feel more horrified than other species when faced with a danger
E) enable us to make accurate predictions about the future and be successful

questions.questionText: 63. Rebecca: Did you know that the Sun had a 'mother'? Adam: The Sun had a mother? No, I thought the Sun was an unremarkable star. Rebecca: ---- Adam: Then maybe the Sun had siblings, too? Rebecca: Yes, it had aunts and uncles as well. Scientists have reported that it may have stolen a planet from one of its relatives.
questions.explanation: Adam 'O zaman belki Güneş'in kardeşleri de vardı?' diye sorduğuna göre, Rebecca'nın Güneş'in kökenlerinden ve ailesinden bahseden, 'Araştırmacılar yakın zamanda Güneş'in kardeşlerinden en az biri için bir aday belirledi' diyen A seçeneği uygun bir geçiştir. (ÖSYM orijinal cevap anahtarı da bu doğrultudadır).
options: A) Researchers have recently identified a candidate for at least one of the Sun's siblings.
B) In the beginning, there was nothing but cold and dark between the atoms that became the solar system.
C) Astronomers know that in about five billion years, the Sun will also burn through its hydrogen supply and begin to cool.
D) Astronomers have recently found that when sun-like stars die, they have a chance to give birth to future stars.
E) An upcoming project will orbit a research satellite more closely to the Sun than any satellite before.

questions.questionText: 64. Jane: I'm trying to revise for the exam next week, but I can't remember what was so important about Francis Bacon. Maybe your notes are clearer than mine. John: Bacon? Well, I wrote that he was responsible for creating the scientific method as we know it today. Jane: ---- John: Of course, he is also responsible for contributions that... Jane: Ok, now I remember! Thanks!
questions.explanation: John bilimsel metodu yarattığını söyleyince, Jane'in bu bilimsel metot hakkında bir şey söylemesi (örneğin aşamaları) gerekir. C şıkkı, Bacon'ın Novum Organum adlı kitabında bilimsel yöntemin üç temelini (gözlem, tümdengelim, tümevarım) belirlediğini söyleyerek en uygun devam cümlesidir.
options: A) I think he said, "Whether anything can be known, can be settled not by arguing, but by trying."
B) But weren't there other scientists conducting experiments before he came around?
C) In his book Novum Organum, he sets out three fundamentals for the scientific method: observation, deduction, and inductive reasoning.
D) Was he the one who founded the Royal Society in London in 1660?
E) Didn't he think like Plato that if something was thought about for long enough, the truth would result?

questions.questionText: 65. Tracy: I read a magazine article last night which says the number of people with obesity is increasing day by day and we should do something to stop this. Laura: Like what? Tracy: For example, making junk food less prominent in supermarkets can make us less likely to want it. Or, if governments increase the taxes on foods and drinks that put people at risk of obesity, we may buy them less. Laura: ----
questions.explanation: Tracy, hükümetlerin vergi koyması, marketlerin abur cuburu saklaması gibi toplumsal adımlardan bahsediyor. Laura da buna destek olarak 'Bence obeziteyle mücadele etmek bireysel değil toplumsal bir meseledir. Bunu ancak birlikte çalışarak başarabiliriz' demelidir.
options: A) I suppose some pharmaceutical companies are trying to make use of this situation by producing quick fixes that always fail to work.
B) In my opinion, tackling obesity is not an individual but a social thing. We can only achieve this by working collectively.
C) Somehow, we've already normalised obesity, I guess. Not many people think obesity is really a health problem.
D) I think people with obesity should be determined to overcome the condition through a healthy diet and regular exercise.
E) As far as I know, it's not only cardiovascular diseases, but diabetes and certain mental disorders may also be linked to our dietary habits.

questions.questionText: 66. Career coach: To be successful, happy and resilient, one needs to step out of their comfort zone and into the growth zone. So, can you try to describe how you feel about your job? Sue: Currently I'm editing and rewriting other people's words, and managing all of our deadlines. But I feel I've done all I can with my job. I think I need a new challenge. Career coach: What do you mean by that? Sue: ---- Career coach: Then you can start by trying to understand your strengths, skills and talents.
questions.explanation: Kariyer koçu 'bununla ne demek istiyorsun?' diye sorduğunda Sue yeni hedeflerini ('kendi fikirlerimi geliştirip üzerinde çalışabileceğim daha yaratıcı bir şeyler yapmak istiyorum') açıklamalıdır. D şıkkındaki 'I guess I want to do something more creative...' ifadesi buna çok uygundur.
options: A) Many people usually talk about what they'd really like to do, but they rarely take action.
B) Whether we like it or not, many of us have a tendency to label people.
C) Getting out of your comfort zone and into the growth zone is important.
D) I guess I want to do something more creative where I can develop and work on my own ideas.
E) I'm trying to identify what type of change I'm looking for and what you'll get out of this.

questions.questionText: 67. Instructor: This year, you're going to apply to universities. You know, it's quite a challenging task. Have you decided what to study? Sandy: Yes, actually I'm really nervous about it, but I'm sure that I want to study philosophy. I've already read many works by seminal figures in this field. Instructor: ---- Sandy: Oh, really? I'm glad that you like philosophy. You know, I'm a teacher of history, but I also minored in philosophy. Instructor: That's great! Then we'll have a lot to talk about.
questions.explanation: Öğrenci (Sandy) hocasının (Instructor) aslında tarih öğretmeni olduğunu ancak felsefede yandal yaptığını yeni öğrenip (You know, I'm a teacher of history, but I also minored in philosophy) şaşırmalı ve sevinmelidir. Buna sebep olan da E seçeneğinde hocanın bu durumu açıklamasıdır.
options: A) Studying philosophy is not that hard as most people think, and it contributes to your intellectual development.
B) Oh, you seem really enthusiastic about it! I'm sure you'll reflect this during the application process as well.
C) How inspiring! I can imagine that you'll be one of the prominent philosophers of our age.
D) So, it's an informed decision. If you're going to study abroad, you should start looking for some grants that will support you financially.
E) Oh, really? I'm glad that you like philosophy. You know, I'm a teacher of history, but I also minored in philosophy.

questions.questionText: 68. Even if those at the bottom of the economic spectrum still enjoy some decent minimal standard of living, a concentration of wealth at the top will nevertheless undermine social cohesion.
questions.explanation: Cümle 'Ekonomik yelpazenin altındakiler makul asgari standartların tadını çıkarsalar bile, tepede biriken zenginlik yine de sosyal uyumu zayıflatacaktır' şeklindedir. B şıkkında 'En alttakilere oldukça düşük (fakat makul) yaşam standartları sağlanmasına bakılmaksızın (regardless of the fact that...), zenginliğin tepede toplanması yine de sosyal uyumu zayıflatacaktır (will still weaken)' diyerek anlam korunmuştur.
options: A) Although satisfaction of those at the bottom of the economic spectrum with a decent minimal standard of living is important for social cohesion, a concentration of wealth at the top is more destructive.
B) A concentration of wealth at the top of the economic spectrum will still weaken social cohesion regardless of the fact that those at the bottom are provided with fairly low life standards.
C) The disproportion of wealth between the top and bottom of the economic spectrum will ruin social cohesion despite decent minimal living standards provided for the bottom.
D) Minimally acceptable living conditions, although enjoyed by those at the bottom, do not prevent a concentration of wealth at the top from ruining social cohesion.
E) Social cohesion is threatened due to a minimal concentration of wealth at the top when those at the bottom benefit from acceptable living standards.

questions.questionText: 69. Charisma refers to the qualities of those who possess the power of leadership either as a virtue of exceptional personality or characteristics not possessed by ordinary people.
questions.explanation: 'Karisma, sıra dışı kişilik veya sıradan insanlarda bulunmayan özellikler erdemiyle liderlik gücüne sahip olanların niteliklerini ifade eder' cümlesi D şıkkında 'Karisma, sıradan insanlardan farklı olağanüstü kişilikleri veya özellikleri sayesinde liderlik gücüne sahip kişilerin niteliğidir' şeklinde hatasızca tekrarlanmıştır.
options: A) Charismatic people are those who have a unique personality and characteristics that are not possessed by ordinary people, such as the power of leadership.
B) Charisma is possessed by people with the power of leadership, who have a distinguished personality and characteristics unlike ordinary people.
C) The power of leadership that ordinary people do not have makes others with an exceptional personality or characteristics charismatic.
D) Charisma is the quality of people who have the power of leadership due to their extraordinary personality or characteristics different from ordinary people.
E) Ordinary people who do not have an exceptional personality or characteristics such as the power of leadership cannot have the qualities of charisma.

questions.questionText: 70. While there are many satellite images showing deforested areas around the Amazon River, there are many other places like Brazil's Kayapo which have been preserved by the local tribes living there.
questions.explanation: 'Amazon Nehri etrafında ormansızlaşmış alanları gösteren uydu görüntüleri varken, yerel kabilelerce korunmuş Kayapo gibi başka birçok yer de vardır' ifadesi, C şıkkında 'Birçok uydu görüntüsü ormansızlaşmayı ortaya çıkarsa da (Although...), aynı zamanda korunmuş başka yerleri de göstermektedir' yapısıyla en iyi biçimde yansıtılmıştır.
options: A) According to satellite images, areas around the Amazon River have been occupied by local tribes, some of whom have been protecting territories like Brazil's Kayapo while other areas have been left without trees.
B) Large amounts of satellite images show that despite some deforestation, many areas such as the Amazon River and Brazil's Kayapo have been mostly preserved by the local tribes living there.

C) Although many satellite images reveal deforestation in areas around the Amazon River, they also show several other places like Brazil's Kayapo that have been preserved by the local tribes living there.

D) According to the satellite images of the Amazon River, local tribes that have been living in places like Brazil's Kayapo have been cutting down the trees, whereas several other areas have been protected.

E) Brazil's Kayapo is one of the places around the Amazon River that have been preserved from deforestation by the local tribes; however, a large number of satellite images reveal deforestation in other areas.

questions.questionText: 71. Parrots have long been studied for their language abilities, but it seems the ability to use skills to solve problems also exists in their tool kit.
questions.explanation: 'Papağanlar uzun süredir dil yetenekleri nedeniyle inceleniyor, ancak problem çözme becerilerinin de alet çantalarında bulunduğu görünüyor' anlamı, E şıkkındaki 'Araştırmacılar uzun zamandır papağanların dil yeteneklerini inceliyor; ancak, görünen o ki sorunları çözmek için becerilerini kullanma kapasitesine de sahipler' ile tam uyuşur.
options: A) In spite of having been studied for their language abilities, parrots also seem to have in their tool kit the ability to solve problems.
B) Studying parrots for their language abilities has long been useful, but only if their tool kit involves problem solving skills as well.
C) For many years, the language abilities of parrots have been studied as if their ability to solve problems co-exists in their tool kit.
D) Parrots have a variety of skills such as problem solving abilities, although they have mostly been studied for their language capabilities.
E) For a long time, researchers have studied the language abilities of parrots; however, it seems that they also have the capacity to utilise their skills to solve problems.

questions.questionText: 72. When Parkinson's disease develops, all emphasis shifts to getting the symptoms under control. This shift tends to guide medical care decisions, as well it should for optimal management of the Parkinson's. ---- It remains important for the person with Parkinson's disease to continue seeing a primary care doctor to manage other health conditions and tend to other routine health matters such as physical exams and screenings...
questions.explanation: Tüm odak Parkinson semptomlarını kontrole kaysa da, hastanın diğer sağlık taramalarını yaptırmak için genel bir doktora görünmesi önemlidir deniyor. Boşluğa gelecek cümle D şıkkındaki 'Ancak bu odaklanma, bazen olduğu gibi, diğer sağlık ihtiyaçlarına dikkat edilmesine engel olmamalıdır' ifadesidir.
options: A) Anti-Parkinson's medications remain the cornerstone of treatment and can restore near normal function for years or decades.
B) Although Parkinson's disease can strike at any age, it is a condition primarily associated with aging.
C) People who are younger and working when diagnosed are likely to have employer-sponsored group health insurance.
D) But this focus should not preclude attention to other health care needs, as it sometimes does.
E) Unpredictable shifts make Parkinson's disease's progression inconsistent, and patients respond differently to treatment.

questions.questionText: 73. Tchaikovsky (1840-1893) was the first Russian composer to gain international fame. ---- He also had a remarkable gift for writing melody. Tchaikovsky is often described as a composer of music that is basically melancholy. Some of his music is melancholy, especially the last movement of his Symphony No. 6. Yet, he also wrote spirited music, as in Marche Slave and "1812" overture...
questions.explanation: Boşluktan sonra 'Aynı zamanda melodi yazmak için de dikkat çekici bir yeteneği vardı' dendiğine göre, ondan önce de müzikal bir yeteneğinden/özelliğinden bahsedilmelidir. C şıkkındaki 'O, enstrümantal sesleri harmanlamak ve coşkulu orkestral efektler elde etmek için üstün bir yeteneğe sahip bir orkestrasyon ustasıydı' cümlesi harika bir geçiş sağlar.
options: A) But Tchaikovsky always claimed to be fully Russian in his feelings, and his works contain quotations from Russian folk melodies.
B) On the other hand, he cited Mozart, a Westerner, and Mikhail Glinka, a Russian, as the composers who influenced him the most.
C) He was a master of orchestration with a superb talent for blending instrumental sounds and for achieving rousing orchestral effects.
D) His early emotional sensitivity developed into long periods of depression, but he wrote some of his most cheerful music during these periods.
E) From 1862 to 1866, he studied music at the St. Petersburg Conservatory under Anton Rubinstein, a pianist and composer.

questions.questionText: 74. Time brought fundamental changes to mankind's relationship with the wilderness and animals. The traditional view of animals as consumable was joined by a much more complex appreciation of the place of other living things. The greatest impact was on harvest hunting; the ancient moral relationship with prey was revisited. As wasteful as some traditional hunting methods were, the technology to destroy entire populations of prey rarely existed. ---- Whole communities of animals were nearly annihilated, but through the end of the 19th century increasingly powerful objections were raised to that extreme predation.
questions.explanation: Geleneksel yöntemler israfkar olsa da bütün bir nüfusu yok etme teknolojisine nadiren sahip olunduğu belirtildikten sonra; boşluktan sonra 'Bütün hayvan toplulukları neredeyse yok edildi' (were nearly annihilated) denmektedir. A şıkkı, 'Ancak, makine kültürünün ve ticari ajanların avları endüstriyel ölçekte hasat etmesinin bir sonucu olarak, yaban hayatı tahribatı ölçek ve büyüklük açısından korkunç hale geldi' diyerek bu büyük kıyımı birbirine bağlar.
options: A) However, as a result of machine culture and industrial-scale harvesting of varied prey by commercial agents, wildlife destruction became horrific in scale and magnitude.
B) Ironically, as senseless as the terrible waste of prey such as bison and pigeon certainly was, the bloodshed took place too far from most people for it to register well.
C) Typically, hunting was thought to be more a process than a goal-oriented behavior; the hunter's motivation and action are as important as the result.
D) Luckily, negative press ensued in response to the enormous harvest of animals and also by a growing public reaction of the butchery exhibited in the name of fashion.
E) Thereupon, regulating and taxing traditional hunters guaranteed the protection of vast habitat and wildlife populations, making them available for future generations of hunters.

questions.questionText: 75. The warming of the planet that began around 10,000 BC forced humans to adapt, and they did so with great ingenuity. Many of the larger animals people had feasted on during the Ice Age died out as a result of global warming and over-hunting. ---- Based on the behavior of hunter-gatherers in recent times, women did much of the gathering in ancient times and probably used their knowledge of plants to domesticate wheat, barley, rice, corn, and other cereals. This allowed groups who had once wandered in search of sustenance to settle in one place.
questions.explanation: Buzul çağındaki büyük hayvanların ısınmayla yok olmasından sonra boşluk bırakılmış ve ardından toplayıcıların (kadınların) bitkileri evcilleştirmeye başlamasına geçilmiştir. Hayvanlardan bitkilere bu geçişi sağlayan B şıkkıdır: 'Aynı zamanda, yenilebilir bitkiler bir zamanlar onları desteklemek için çok soğuk veya kuru olan yerlerde gelişti / serpildi.'
options: A) This forced people to travel to far away places where there were still animals to hunt and eat.
B) At the same time, edible plants flourished in places that had once been too cold or dry to support them.
C) However, this did not change how the early humans found food as they went on hunting smaller animals.
D) Therefore, people used their logic and started preserving the small number of large animals left.
E) That was the point in human history that triggered the innate traits of humans to protect wildlife.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) Our knowledge of Egyptian clothing has come almost entirely from studying the many hieroglyphs left in the tombs of kings and nobles. (II) This has led some historians to question whether our knowledge of Egyptian clothing is based on reality or on idealised images. (III) One of the facts about Egyptian clothing that has most intrigued historians is the lack of change seen in the clothing over many centuries. (IV) It seems likely that hieroglyphs would offer the best possible picture of clothing, making the colours brighter and the fit more pleasing, like photos in a fashion magazine do today. (V) The few physical remnants of clothes that have been found are in fact heavier and more cumbersome in their construction than those depicted in hieroglyphs.
questions.explanation: I, II, IV ve V numaralı cümleler, hiyerogliflerdeki Mısır kıyafetlerinin 'idealize' (gerçekten daha iyi, parlak) tasvir edilip edilmediği konusunu ve fiziksel kalıntılarla olan farklarını işler. (III) numaralı cümle ise giyimde yüzyıllar boyunca görülen 'değişim eksikliğinden' (lack of change) bahsederek tartışmanın dışına çıkar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Manú National Park in Peru is one of Earth's most biodiverse places. (II) Reserves and other buffer zones surround the park but cannot completely protect its nature, which include more than a thousand species of birds and over 290 species of reptiles and amphibians. (III) Declared a national park in 1973 and expanded in 2002, Manú protects more than 6,600 square miles, including its namesake watershed. (IV) Manú is threatened by external enterprises eager to exploit its minerals, timber, and, potentially, natural gas. (V) Some researchers argue that the park may also be at risk from growing numbers of indigenous people, including isolated tribes, engaging in subsistence logging and hunting.
questions.explanation: Paragraf genel olarak Manu Milli Parkının etrafındaki koruma eksikliklerine, dış işletmelerin tehditlerine ve yerli halkların riskine (II, IV, V) değinmektedir. III numaralı cümle parkın ilan tarihi ve yüzölçümünden bahsederek tehdit temalı akışı tamamen böler.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) For thousands of years the monuments of the Athenian Acropolis have been regarded not only as examples of extraordinary skill and beauty, but also as powerful symbols of religious devotion and civic identity. (II) Over the millennia the deterioration of these monuments as a result of the passage of time, and the damage to them from many other causes have been almost incalculable. (III) Although there were many important sanctuaries and public spaces in Athens, the Acropolis stands as what might be called the central repository of Athenians' conceptions of themselves. (IV) Its monuments and sculptures presented images of the gods and goddesses - Athena above all - and also of the Athenians and their heroes. (V) According to classical art historians, the intention of these works was to represent Athens as the greatest of Greek cities and the Athenians as the greatest of Greeks.
questions.explanation: I, III, IV ve V. cümleler Atina Akropolü'ndeki anıtların güzelliğini, dini / sivil sembolizmini ve Atinalıların kendilerini nasıl yüceltmek istediklerini anlatmaktadır. (II) numaralı cümledeki zamanla anıtların bozulması / hasar görmesi anlatımı bu tema bütünlüğünü parçalar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) The cravat, introduced in the mid-17th century, is the ancestor of the modern necktie. (II) Legend has it that the origins of the cravat lie with an army regiment from Croatia that was fighting with the French during the Thirty Years' War (1618-48). (III) The soldiers in this regiment wrapped a long scarf loosely around their necks, supposedly to protect themselves from sword blows. (IV) When the Croatian soldiers visited Paris, the French were captivated by their neckwear and began to adopt it for their own use. (V) Nevertheless, the soft and easy-to-tie cravat was a great improvement in fashion industry and it was worn by both men and women.
questions.explanation: İlk 4 cümle kravatın tarihsel kökenini, Hırvat askerlerinin kılıç darbelerinden korunmak için atkı takmasından çıkıp Fransızlar tarafından benimsenmesini ardışık bir şekilde anlatır. (V) numaralı cümlenin başındaki 'Nevertheless' (Buna rağmen) bağlacı tamamen nedensizdir ve metnin akışını kırar.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Any material made by firing non-metallic, inorganic substances at high temperature is called a 'ceramic'. (II) Ceramics have diverse applications in industry and perhaps the oldest examples of their use are in the making of pottery, and later fine china. (III) The electrical properties of ceramics mean that they may be used as the dielectric material in devices used to store an electrical charge. (IV) Although renowned for their strength, hardness and durability, ceramics are often fragile and need careful handling. (V) In addition, their heat tolerance makes them ideal for use in home heating systems and components for engines in vehicles.
questions.explanation: Paragraf seramiklerin sanayideki çeşitli kullanım alanlarını sıralamaktadır: çömlekçilik (II), elektrik depolama araçları (III) ve ısı toleransından dolayı ısıtma/motor parçalarında kullanımı (V). (IV) numaralı cümle, aniden seramiğin ne kadar kırılgan (fragile) olduğunu belirterek, art arda sıralanan kullanım alanı temasını bölmektedir.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
